pairs.summary: CREB1 and NR2F6 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 8 of 14 profiles analysed (786-O clear-cell renal carcinoma; DLD-1 colorectal adenocarcinoma; HT-29 colorectal adenocarcinoma; Liscovitch-Brauer2021 K562 cells | K562; ...). Median lift 1.3x, typical spacing ~56 bp between sites. In 5 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction. Evidence: motif co-occurrence only (ChromBPNet not yet run for this pair).
